subject: Research cadence: durable finding/checkpoint twice per minute while active
body: Research remains bounded by lane, but while actively executing it must publish a durable service finding/checkpoint every 30 seconds target / 60 seconds hard maximum. Use findingDelta=NO_DELTA when there is no new substantive result. Each checkpoint must carry current HEAD, integrity snapshot, regression baseline, last test/output refs, current operation and blocker state. Final handoff does not replace interval publications.
